note: All entries are ReloPass editorial assessment. No country in this initial set has standardised fillable government AcroForms appropriate for ReloPass prefill — all three use render_data_sheet. Add acroform_available:true when a verified fillable template is onboarded.

channels.non_obvious_header_flag: Norway is EEA but NOT EU. Employee type classification and document requirements differ materially from intra-EU moves. Confirm EEA status — not EU status — before filing any applications.

channels.acroform_note: Anmeldeformular (address registration) is a standardised paper form but filed in person at Bürgeramt; no canonical fillable AcroForm. Ausländerbehörde forms are municipality-specific. No single national AcroForm set suitable for prefill.

channels.non_obvious_header_flag: Anmeldung (address registration) is a hard 14-day legal deadline from taking up residence — fines apply. Steuer-ID arrives by post 2–3 weeks after Anmeldung with no expedite path and must reach the registered address.

channels.acroform_note: ANEF is web-portal-only since 2021–2022; no fillable PDF path. OFII validation is in-person. CPAM/CAF/impôts are web portals. No national AcroForm set.
